title: Finite-stage detection on affine tail
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-affine-stage-eventual-zero, for i₀ ≤ i, every class at i whose comparison image is zero vanishes at a later stage.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), cofinal-tail reduction; categories.tex Tag 04AX (section-directed-colimits) for eventual equality. Source statements checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04AX on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: The named tail-colimit comparison theorem supplies IsColimit for B restricted to the upper tail of i0. Equip that tail with its nonempty directed preorder structure. The forgetful functor from AddCommGrpCat preserves these filtered colimits, including the smaller indexing universes. Regard i with i0 <= i as an object of the tail. Its comparison images of x and zero agree by the hypothesis and additivity. Apply CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.eq_iff' to x and zero, producing a later tail object j and a transition f whose images agree. Since H.map f preserves zero, its image of x is zero. Map j and f through the tail inclusion to obtain the original-index witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YQ, affine-tail comparison followed by filtered-colimit eventual equality (Tag 04AX). Lean reduction by D3 on 2026-10-13.

theorem etale_limit_affine_stage_eventual_zero_tail
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (p : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) p))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) p) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt p))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) p))
    (i₀ : I) [IsAffine (D.obj (op i₀))] :
    ∀ (i : I) (_hi : i₀ ≤ i) (x : H.obj i), (B.ι.app i).hom x = 0 →
      ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), (H.map f).hom x = 0
